test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the following steps of the Union Budget preparation in the correct order:**

P. The finance minister presents the budget in Parliament

Q. The Ministry of Finance collects estimates from various ministries

R. The budget is passed by both houses of Parliament

S. The Cabinet approves the final draft of the budget
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Union Budget preparation involves a sequence of well-defined steps to ensure accuracy and transparency.
 
• **Step Q:** The Ministry of Finance collects estimates from various ministries. This is the starting point where all financial requirements and projections are gathered.
 
• **Step S:** The Cabinet approves the final draft of the budget. After collecting estimates, the budget is reviewed and approved at the highest level.
 
• **Step P:** The finance minister presents the budget in Parliament. Once approved by the Cabinet, the budget is presented for discussion and debate.
 
• **Step R:** The budget is passed by both houses of Parliament. After due deliberation and any necessary amendments, the budget receives approval.
 
• The correct order of steps is **Q → S → P → R**, as mentioned in **Option 2**.
